title: tc-ghost-completion
description: A text field with dimmed AI suggestions after the caret – Tab accepts, Ctrl/⌘ + → takes a word, Escape dismisses.

placeholder.description: Shown while the field is empty and there's no suggestion

suggestion.description: A suggestion the page sets itself: the text to show after what's typed. Typing that matches it uses it up

debounce.description: How long typing must pause before `suggest` is asked, in ms

labels.description: Words the page can rename, merged over defaultGhostCompletionLabels
